hook.rumour: Relief ships bound for Kvatch keep running aground on dark nights north of Anvil, and the dressed stone meant for Kvatch's walls is turning up in private coastal villas.
hook.notice: ANVIL HARBOUR & KVATCH REBUILDING FUND: Urgent commission to trace the missing masonry convoys and investigate the false beacon lights along the Gold Coast.

stages.objective: Audit the Kvatch relief manifests at Anvil's harbourmaster office
Question the teamsters at Brina Cross Inn about the diverted stone-wains
Deliver the surviving mortar-wagons to the masons' camp at Kvatch

objectives.text: Audit the Kvatch relief manifests at Anvil's harbourmaster office
Question the teamsters at Brina Cross Inn about the diverted stone-wains
Deliver the surviving mortar-wagons to the masons' camp at Kvatch

consequence_detail.summary: The harbour manifests show half of Kvatch's reconstruction stone was signed away by a speculator using Council of Ash letters of credit.

stages.objective: Trace the stolen crane-chains down from Kvatch toward Marja's Mill
Inspect the smuggler oil-casks hidden behind Marja's Mill
Clear the wrecker lookouts near Gottshaw Inn and smash their false signal-lantern

objectives.text: Trace the stolen crane-chains down from Kvatch toward Marja's Mill
Inspect the smuggler oil-casks hidden behind Marja's Mill
Clear the wrecker lookouts near Gottshaw Inn and smash their false signal-lantern

consequence_detail.summary: The wreckers' shuttered lantern near Gottshaw Inn is destroyed, saving the Abecean timber ships bound for Anvil.

stages.objective: Follow the wrecker paymaster's trail south toward The Withered Rose
Seize the speculator's ledger of Oblivion-glass shipments at The Withered Rose
Locate the hidden excavation shaft beneath the Great Gate scar at Kvatch

objectives.text: Follow the wrecker paymaster's trail south toward The Withered Rose
Seize the speculator's ledger of Oblivion-glass shipments at The Withered Rose
Locate the hidden excavation shaft beneath the Great Gate scar at Kvatch

consequence_detail.summary: Council of Ash agents have been stalling Kvatch's rebuild so they can strip sigil-scorched glass from the cavern under the bluff.

stages.objective: Descend into the ash-cavern beneath Kvatch and defeat Speculator-Prefect Titus Vane
Seal the Oblivion fissure and return the stolen reconstruction chest to Kvatch's masons
Proclaim the Gold Coast Reconstruction Charter at Castle Anvil

objectives.text: Descend into the ash-cavern beneath Kvatch and defeat Speculator-Prefect Titus Vane
Seal the Oblivion fissure and return the stolen reconstruction chest to Kvatch's masons

consequence_detail.summary: The ash-fissure under Kvatch is sealed, the wreckers are broken, and Anvil's ships unload full cargoes of dressed stone for Kvatch's new walls.
